'''Rhommamool''' was an impoverished [[Mining/Legends|mining]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] in the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]], along the [[Corellian Run/Legends|Corellian Run]]. It was in the same system as [[Osarian]].

==Geography==
Rhommamool was an unpleasant place by the most generous of standards. It was a small, dusty [[Mining/Legends|mining]] planet in the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]], with no natural resources capable of sustaining life. [[Water/Legends|Water]] and food had to be imported for the miners who lived there, and the few mining compounds erected on the planet’s surface were cramped and foreboding. The wind howled constantly, and the environment itself proved hazardous to all but the few native creatures that dwelt beneath the low red sky.<ref name="UA" />

[[File:Quosits.jpg|230px|left|thumb|Quosits were beings that inhabited the underground]]
Most of the creatures that survived on the planet did so underground, where conditions had been slightly more favorable for life. There had been very few predators, as most species were either too small or too scarce to support a lasting predatory cycle. The majority drew sustenance from the soil, fungus, or odd form of subterranean plant life. Among these creatures, the flying [[quosit]] was the one most often encountered by miners, owing to its unusual reproductive needs. The difficulty was that the quosit, alone among the catalogued species of Rhommamool, required a living host in which to implant its eggs. The hatchlings demanded far more nourishment than a parent could provide from anything else in the natural environment, so the creatures sought out larger hosts to carry their young until they matured.<ref name="UA" />

An exception among the withered nature of the planet were the [[Reptile/Legends|reptiles]] known as [[tutakan]]s, which were large enough to be used as riding animals.<ref name="VP" />

Rhommamool was an inhospitable desert world with red sands. Life on the planet was tough for its inhabitants with even basic essentials like water lacking. However, Rhommamool had large reserves of valuable minerals which would be exploited by the government of neighboring Osarian.<ref name="VP" />

Rhommamool orbited the wealthier Osarian with the latter using the former as a dumping ground for convicted criminals and a mining colony. The two planets orbited each other and were brought together within a million kilometers of each other every ten years, usually resulting in a flare-up of hostilities between the two.<ref name="VP" />

The planetary capital was at [[Redhaven]] which contained the planetary spaceport and the [[Square of Hopeful Redemption]] which was built from the ruins of the [[Portmaster's Pavilion]] following an uprising around [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]].<ref name="VP" />

==History==
===Colonization===
Rhommamool was settled by convicted criminals brought in by the Osarians as de facto slave labor for the planet's mines. Much of the profit from these mines went to fuel the lifestyle of the richer Osarians. Although the worlds shared a single government, it was based on Osarian and dominated by Osarians.<ref name="VP" />

The situation largely stayed under control due to the fact that neither planet had extensive space forces. However, every ten years their orbits would bring the worlds within a million kilometers of each other, close enough for each planet's ground-based nuclear missiles to hit each other if launched. At those times of closest contact, the conflict would flare up. Until the close encounter of [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]], the worlds managed to hold off attacking one another.<ref name="VP" />

===Jedi Civil War===
During the [[Jedi Civil War]], the planet was the location of a [[Battle of Rhommamool|battle]] between the [[Darth Revan's Sith Empire|Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. The Republic won the battle.<ref name="TEA" />

===Clone Wars===
Rhommamool was loyal to the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="TEA" />

===Imperial era===
As of [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]], a small [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] presence was established around Rhommamool.<ref name="TFUn" />

===New Republic era===
Prior to [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]], [[Nom Anor]] was dispatched by the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] to the planet to stir up dissent between the poorer Rhommamoolians and their richer Osarian cousins.<ref name="TEC">[[The Essential Chronology (real-world book)|''The Essential Chronology'']]</ref><ref name="TNEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> Using a [[Ooglith masquer|disguise]], Nom Anor drew disciples to his cause by preaching hatred towards all forms of technology including [[Droid/Legends|droids]] and [[Landspeeder/Legends|landspeeders]], the hated Osarians and the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. These disciples became known as the [[Red Knights of Life]] due to their red cloaks.<ref name="VP" />

In [[13 ABY/Legends|13 ABY]], [[Diplomat/Legends|Emissary]] [[Xbrr-Zinngogg]] of Rhommamool went to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] in order to warn the [[New Republic Ruling Council]] about Nom Anor's attempts of destabilization in the [[Osarian system]]. [[Chief of State (New Republic)/Legends|Chief of State]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]] refused to intervene, considering this situation as a local matter.<ref name="CE3" />

In 25 ABY, the Red Knights of Life launched a planetary uprising which captured the capital Redhaven where a provisional [[Rhommamoolian Senate|independent senate]] was installed to rule the planet. During this period, the Red Knights of Life launched a violent crusade against mechanical technology and presumably Osarian collaborators as well. Their actions ranged from attacking civilians simply for using a landspeeder to rounding up all the droids they could find and dumping them at the [[Square of Hopeful Redemption]] in Redhaven. There, they would throw droids into a large pit and bombard them with rocks until they were nothing but a pile of metal, one of whom was [[C-9PO (Rhommamool)|C-9PO]].<ref name="VP" />

During the [[Osarian-Rhommamool conflict]], Nom Anor ordered a [[Battle of Osarian|missile strike]] against the Osarian capital of [[Osa-Prime]] when the orbits of both planets were at their closest, destroying the city and causing the political conflict to become a war. More missiles would be fired by Rhommamool, destroying more Osarian cities. Large red thermonuclear blast clouds also appeared over the planet, presumably causing harm to millions of Osarians.<ref name="VP" />

During the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], the world was eventually [[Battle of Rhommamool (Yuuzhan Vong War)|conquered]] and held by the Yuuzhan Vong.<ref name="TEA" />
